meta_description: Paul Green Decorator in Nottingham offers interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, reliable local service. Call 07779 306503.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting done right. From fresh walls to complete refurbishment—free quote within 48 hours.
services_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a full house renovation, Paul handles interior and exterior projects with attention to detail and minimal disruption.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Full redecoration of living spaces, bedrooms, and bathrooms. We prep walls properly, choose the right finishes, and leave you with a flawless result.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior paint work including fascia, soffits, and door frames. Built to last and protect your home from the elements.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Feature walls, full room coverage, or specialist finishes. We match patterns perfectly and remove old paper cleanly.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim
services.desc: Painting doors, skirting boards, picture rails, and built-ins. Precision work that transforms the detail of your home.

services.title: Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: We don't cut corners on prep. Cracks filled, surfaces sanded, and primers applied correctly—the foundation of a lasting finish.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Office spaces, retail units, and care facilities decorated to your brief. Scheduled around your working hours with minimal fuss.

about_pullquote: I do the work I'd want done in my own home. That's the only way to run this.
about_para_1: Paul Green Decorator has been transforming homes and businesses across Nottingham for over 15 years. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local name, built entirely on repeat customers and word-of-mouth recommendations. Paul trained as a decorator in the 1990s and has kept pace with modern techniques—from eco-friendly paints to specialist finishes—whilst staying true to old-school craftsmanship.
about_para_2: Customers come back because Paul turns up on time, communicates clearly about costs, and leaves sites clean and tidy. He's not interested in chasing volume or cutting corners. Every job—whether a small bedroom refresh or a full commercial refurb—gets the same meticulous preparation and finish. He's based in Rise Park and serves the whole of Nottingham and surrounding areas.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Paul Green

reviews.text: Paul came recommended by a mate. Did our hallway and lounge—absolutely spot on. Turned up when he said he would, protected all the furniture, and the paint work is brilliant. Pricing was fair too. Will definitely have him back for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: We had Paul do the exterior of our Victorian terrace. The prep work was thorough and he chose exactly the right paint for the age of the house. It's been three years and it still looks fresh. Would recommend without hesitation.
reviews.author: Helen D.

reviews.text: First-class work. Paul wallpapered our feature wall and painted the rest of the lounge. Couldn't fault him—clean, professional, and he sorted a tricky corner beautifully. Has already quoted us for the kitchen. Five stars.
reviews.author: James P.
